tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbon po lha rgyal nas bskul ngor sde dge'i gdung rabs myur 'byon phrin bcol// hūm̐ rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus rdo rje gur/ /grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ral gcig ma/ /srid gsum kun la dbang sgyur re ma ti/ /ma rungs bdud kyi stobs 'phrog zhal bzhi pa/ /phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i yum chen bzhi/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs dam can nor skyong zung / /dregs pa'i ded dpon gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ /dam nyams gshed ma rū tra ming sring gsum/ /dpal gyi bka' nyan dkar bdud phur srung tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sgo gsum nyes ltung ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las myur du mdzad par bskul/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos dam bzhag dang / /bdag cag yon mchod gsol btab rjes dgongs la/ /sde bzhi dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i mi dbang mchog /'khor bcas kun gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /lung rtogs yon tan tshe dang bsod nams sogs/ /mthun rkyen phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa dang / /khams gsum 'gro ba mtha' dag dbang bsdus nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la 'god pa dang / /phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs log 'dren kun/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du tshar bcad nas/ /thugs bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i rigs rgyud tshogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mkhas grub lo paṇa dang / /rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'i rnam sprul mchog /chad med myur du byon nas spyi bye brag /bstan pa mi nyams dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba'i/ /rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin bzang po phyogs dus su/ /dar rgyas yun du brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas kyang /

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ci bsam kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge sa dbang mchog gi gdung rabs rin po che'i phreng ba myur du byon nas sa ngor rnam dkar ring lugs kyis mtshon rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chu bo'i rgyun ltar spel phyir bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phrin bcol smon tshig gcig dgos zhes phyag mdzod dbon po lha rgyal ye shes rgya mtshos bskur ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos de don bzhin sbyar ba dge zhing rtsa yig pa ni gzhu lung pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ye/ hūm̐ rgyud gsum dregs pa'i ded dpon rdo rje gur/ /yum chen ral gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po yum bzhi dregs pa'i tshogs/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bstan 'gro 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa dang / /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun kun zhi bsam don lhun grub nas/ /phrin las rnam bzhi gang bcol myur du sgrubs/ /sa lam bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// //ces pa 'di yang lha btsun ngag dbang lhun grub dar rgyas kyi zhal 'don du sa skya pa kun blos gsung bris 'byor 'phral phul/ maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ sde dge'i gdung rabs myur byon phrin bcol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
